responsibility: This header declares the machine-description reader API and the shared data types used to represent .md source locations, names, constants, enums, and overloaded pattern names. It defines the md_reader and rtx_reader class interfaces, input traversal and location-reporting hooks, include callback support, enum/constant traversal helpers, and the public helper functions that gen* programs and RTL readers use to parse, inspect, and annotate GCC machine-description files.
same_name_distinction: Header that defines the machine-description reader API and shared types such as file_location, md_name, md_constant, enum_type, overloaded_name, and the md_reader/rtx_reader class interfaces. Unlike gcc/read-md.cc, it provides the declarations and abstractions used by readers and generators, not the concrete logic for traversing and parsing .md files.
